name: chatbot
title: Chatbot
description: A /chat page with streaming Claude replies. Runs in demo mode (canned replies) until you add your own Anthropic API key.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.comment:
Chatbot kit: your team's OWN Anthropic API key (platform.claude.com > API keys). Server-only.
Empty = demo mode with canned replies. Put the real key in .env.local and your Vercel project, never here.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_MODEL
env.comment: Optional. Claude model id for the chatbot. Empty = claude-opus-5-5.

next: Open /chat (it runs in demo mode until you add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to .env.local). Then edit lib/chatbot/system-prompt.ts to give the bot its job. Read kits/chatbot/README.md before adding a key.
